[vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content_no_spaces" el_id="no-top-space"][vc_column]
[vc_raw_html][/vc_raw_html]
[vc_raw_html][/vc_raw_html]
[vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_africon_sponsors{margin:0 !important;padding:0 !important;}"]
<div class="africon-page africon-sponsors">
<div class="page-hero">
      <div class="container">
        <h1>Sponsors &amp; Exhibitors</h1>
        <div class="africon-breadcrumb">
          <a href="https://2027.ieee-africon.org/">Home</a> &rsaquo; Sponsors/Exhibitors
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="page-layout">
      <aside class="sidebar">
        <h3>Sponsors</h3>
        <ul>
          <li><a href="#sponsors">Our Sponsors</a></li>
          <li><a href="#exhibitors">Exhibitors</a></li>
          <li><a href="#opportunities">Sponsorship Opportunities</a></li>
        </ul>
      </aside>

      <div class="page-content">
        <h2 id="sponsors">Our Sponsors</h2>
        <p>
          IEEE AFRICON 2027 is grateful for the support of our generous
          sponsors. Sponsorship announcements will be made progressively.
        </p>

        <div class="sponsor-tier">
          <h3 style="color: #c9a227">
            <i class="fa fa-star"></i> Platinum Sponsors
          </h3>
          <div class="sponsor-grid tier-platinum">
            <div class="sponsor-box">
              Your Logo Here<br /><span
                style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--ieee-blue)"
                >Become a Sponsor</span
              >
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="sponsor-tier">
          <h3 style="color: #c9a227">
            <i class="fa fa-star"></i> Gold Sponsors
          </h3>
          <div class="sponsor-grid tier-gold">
            <div class="sponsor-box">
              Your Logo Here<br /><span
                style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--ieee-blue)"
                >Become a Sponsor</span
              >
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="sponsor-tier">
          <h3 style="color: #aaa">
            <i class="fa fa-star-half-alt"></i> Silver Sponsors
          </h3>
          <div class="sponsor-grid tier-silver">
            <div class="sponsor-box">Your Logo Here</div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="sponsor-tier">
          <h3 style="color: #c0713c">
            <i class="fa fa-award"></i> Bronze Sponsors
          </h3>
          <div class="sponsor-grid tier-bronze">
            <div class="sponsor-box">Your Logo Here</div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <h2 id="exhibitors" style="margin-top: 36px">Exhibitors</h2>
        <p>
          Exhibitor enquiries for IEEE AFRICON 2027 are now open. Showcase
          your products, services, and innovations to an international audience
          of engineers, researchers, students, and industry professionals. Use
          the <a href="https://2027.ieee-africon.org/contact-us/#message">conference contact form</a> and
          select <strong>Sponsorship</strong> for exhibition floor plans and booking.
        </p>

        <h2 id="opportunities" style="margin-top: 36px">
          Sponsorship Opportunities
        </h2>
        <p>
          Sponsoring IEEE AFRICON 2027 provides your organization with
          unparalleled visibility among Africa's top engineers and technology
          professionals. We offer flexible sponsorship packages to suit every
          budget and objective.
        </p>

        <table class="package-table">
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th>Benefit</th>
              <th>Platinum<br /><small>USD 10,000+</small></th>
              <th>Gold<br /><small>USD 6,000</small></th>
              <th>Silver<br /><small>USD 3,500</small></th>
              <th>Bronze<br /><small>USD 1,500</small></th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            <tr>
              <td>Logo on conference website</td>
              <td class="check">✔</td>
              <td class="check">✔</td>
              <td class="check">✔</td>
              <td class="check">✔</td>
            </tr>
            <tr>
              <td>Logo in proceedings</td>
              <td class="check">✔</td>
              <td class="check">✔</td>
              <td class="check">✔</td>
              <td class="check">✔</td>
            </tr>
            <tr>
              <td>Complimentary registrations</td>
              <td>5</td>
              <td>3</td>
              <td>2</td>
              <td>1</td>
            </tr>
            <tr>
              <td>Exhibition booth</td>
              <td>Premium (2×)</td>
              <td>Standard (1×)</td>
              <td>—</td>
              <td>—</td>
            </tr>
            <tr>
              <td>Plenary-area sponsor acknowledgement (technical content remains independent)</td>
              <td class="check">✔</td>
              <td>—</td>
              <td>—</td>
              <td>—</td>
            </tr>
            <tr>
              <td>Banner at venue</td>
              <td class="check">✔</td>
              <td class="check">✔</td>
              <td>—</td>
              <td>—</td>
            </tr>
            <tr>
              <td>Social media mentions</td>
              <td class="check">✔</td>
              <td class="check">✔</td>
              <td class="check">✔</td>
              <td>—</td>
            </tr>
          </tbody>
        </table>

        <p>
          Sponsorship recognition is commercial and does not provide influence
          over peer review, paper acceptance, keynote selection, speaker
          invitations, awards, or any other technical programme decision.
          Package prices and benefits remain subject to approval by the AFRICON
          Steering Committee and IEEE Region 8.
        </p>

        <p style="margin-top: 20px">
          To discuss sponsorship opportunities, use the
          <a href="https://2027.ieee-africon.org/contact-us/#message">conference contact form</a> and select
          <strong>Sponsorship</strong>.
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
</div>
[/vc_column_text]
[/vc_column][/vc_row]
